master.definition_en: A nonspecific term referring to impaired vision. Major subcategories include stimulus deprivation-induced amblyopia and toxic amblyopia. Stimulus deprivation-induced amblyopia is a developmental disorder of the visual cortex. A discrepancy between visual information received by the visual cortex from each eye results in abnormal cortical development. strabismus and refractive errors may cause this condition. Toxic amblyopia is a disorder of the optic nerve which is associated with alcoholism, tobacco smoking, and other toxins and as an adverse effect of the use of some medications.

master.definition_en: Spinal meningioma isa rare type of spinal cord cancer. The spinal cord is part of the central nervous system. This tumor often affects middle-aged women. Tumors of the spinal cord can be either primary or arise from other primary tumors (metastatic), and are typically slow growing. The initial signs and symptoms include headacheand recent onset of seizures. Other features are motor deficits, sensory deficits, pain, and sphincter dysfunction. The thoracic spine (middle back) is the most common site, followed by the cervical spine (neck). These tumors are rarely seen in the lumbar region (lower back). T he only proven risk factor in the development of meningioma is exposure to ionizing radiation. Also, patients with neurofibromatosis type 2 are at increased risk of developing meningioma. Surgery is the treatment of choice and complete tumor removal is reached in the vast majority of patients. The prognosis after surgical resection is excellent.

Hypotonia, neonatal respiratory distress necessitating ventilation, and severe dysphagia have also been reported. The disease is of variable severity and non- or slowly progressive. curated.lethality_detail_zh: 无基础肝病者在起病26周内（常于数日至2周内）出现大块或亚大块肝细胞坏死，迅速继发严重凝血功能障碍（INR≥1.5）、肝性脑病昏迷、恶性脑水肿/脑疝、低血糖及多器官衰竭；若未及时获得急诊肝移植，中国多中心研究报告其自发住院病死率高达60%-63.28%。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 急诊肝移植是唯一被证实对King's College高危急性肝衰竭具有确定性挽救生命的手段（术后1年生存率>75%-85%）；药物治疗除对乙酰氨基酚中毒用N-乙酰半胱氨酸外缺乏特效逆转药，主要依靠人工肝支持系统（ALSS）清除毒素替代肝功“桥接”等待肝细胞再生或移植。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO与GBD死因清单未将急性肝衰竭单列（常归入病毒性肝炎、药物毒性损伤或急性肝病）；全球在未行急诊肝移植时代的自发死亡率超过50%-80%

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国无全国单列ALF年度死亡总数；中国多中心研究显示药物及中草药（TCM/HDS）相关急性肝衰竭住院自发死亡率达60%-63.28%，核心死因为重度出血、脑病昏迷与极低肝移植率

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 欧美发达地区以对乙酰氨基酚（扑热息痛）过量中毒占急性肝衰竭首位（约占40%-50%），全球总体年发病率约1-6例/百万人年，罕见但极高致死率。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国308家医疗中心研究显示全国住院药物性肝损伤（DILI）一般人群年发病率达23.80/10万人（高于西方），其中中草药/膳食补充剂（>26%）与抗结核药为最重要致因，连同急性乙肝爆发及毒蕈中毒构成中国ALF主力病因。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: ICU极重危抢救路径：1) 不论是否明确为对乙酰氨基酚中毒，早期非扑热息痛型早期ALF亦推荐静脉输注N-乙酰半胱氨酸（NAC）改善非移植生存率；2) 对急性HBV爆发性复制者即刻予恩替卡韦/替诺福韦强效抑毒；3) 入住ICU严密气道保护、床头抬高30°、静脉甘露醇或高渗盐水防治脑水肿脑疝、持续监测血糖预防致死性低血糖、酌情预防消化道出血及广谱防感染；4) 早期启动人工肝支持（血浆置换PE、DPMAS双重血浆分子吸附）降低高胆红素与炎症风暴；5) 一经达到King's College移植标准即刻启动极危重加急肝移植评估。

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。
